admitted_result.data: Twelve literal official EXFOR M0475002 DATA-CM/ERR-S rows at213,258,330MeV and46,61,73,87degrees. Six M0475003 totals remain a separate disjoint-energy table.
admitted_result.model: Per-energy finite reflection-even nonnegative Bernstein coefficient cones atdegree4/8, endpoint-free/endpoint-zero, nominal-angle arithmetic enclosures, declared uniform azimuth and fixed inherited same-event detector geometry.
admitted_result.certificate: Inner-to-true-to-outer polytope inclusion; compactness and positive normalization; exact exhaustive active-set vertices; ordered geometry coefficients; linear-fractional extrema with saved exact witnesses.
logical_limits: Sensitivity windows do not establish simultaneous confidence coverage.
The coefficient cone is a sufficient positivity family, not all nonnegative angular laws.
Endpoint-zero is an unmeasured extrapolation assumption.
Outer extremizers need not be nominally feasible fits. Inner witnesses are feasible nominal fits, but geometric objective values remain enclosed.
Empty outer families exclude only the named finite model/window combinations; no global no-go or experiment rejection is admitted.
Positive common scale cancels separately at fixed energy; actual target response, encounter history, full law and absolute heating remain input-gated.
